cases.translation: When the queen heard about this.
cases.explain: The noun stands as the subject of the sentence.

cases.translation: All the people of the land rejoiced.
cases.explain: The noun stands in nominative as the subject.

cases.sentence: И заключил соглашение между Господом, царем и ___ народом.
cases.translation: And made a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people.
cases.explain: The preposition между (between) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altar.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Came to the palace by the gate of the guard.
cases.explain: The noun in possessive construction takes the genitive case.

cases.translation: Set up oversight of the house of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition за (over) with instrumental expresses authority.

cases.sentence: А ___ после того был в мире.
cases.translation: And the city after that was at peace.
cases.explain: The noun stands as the subject of был (was).

cases.translation: The king sat on the royal throne.
cases.explain: The verb сел (sat on) takes the accusative case.
